title: Git references: list matching references
claim: Returns matching references as an array; endpoint parameters contain no page or per_page and no documented pagination threshold.

title: GitHub REST pagination
claim: Paginated responses signal next pages in Link; page-size support is endpoint-specific.

title: Repository contents
claim: Directory listing has a 1000-entry limit; 1–100MB object content may have encoding none and empty content; files over 100MB are unsupported.

title: Search limitations
claim: Search provides up to 1000 results; incomplete_results marks possible time-limited result omission. Search has index/access/scope restrictions.

title: gh search code export
claim: JSON export writes results.Items, not Total or IncompleteResults.

title: gh code search paging
claim: CLI already follows page links to its requested limit; it is not a first-page-only client.

title: Get a branch
claim: Specific-branch GET is a single branch object, unlike List branches.

title: Get a repository
claim: Specific repository lookup supplies default_branch as a single object.

title: Get an annotated tag
claim: Specific annotated-tag GET supplies its referenced object, not a paginated list.
